Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted “pure dominant” (which means homozygous dominant, RR) as heterozygous (Rr), leading to the incorrect prediction of a 1:1 round-to-wrinkled offspring ratio. Consequently, selected a non-existent option labeling (“B) 50% round and 50% wrinkled”) instead of the correct choice (A: all round), and prematurely marked the task complete.
